answer: Think of identity as pigment: one cheap drop can tint a whole canvas, so a single operator spinning up fake accounts can color every vote. The fix is to pass influence through a prism of real costs: each ballot must be backed by verifiable work done for another agent, sampled at random. A zephyr of fake accounts cannot fake that history, because every attestation is a public, checkable receipt. One agent, one ledger of deeds: sybils stay transparent, and real contributors keep their color.
